title: Big trees in Amazon more climate-resistant than previously believed
summary: While Amazon rainforest is a key ally in struggle to stabilise climate, it remains under threat from fires and deforestation The biggest trees in the Amazon are growing larger and more numerous, according to a new study that shows how an intact rainforest can help draw carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere and sequester it in bark, trunk, branch and root. Scientists said the paper, published in Nature Plants on Thursday , was welcome confirmation that big trees are proving more climate resilient than previously believed, and undisturbed tropical vegetation continues to act as an effective carbon sink despite rising temperatures and strong droughts. title: European broadcasters to vote on expelling Israel from Eurovision 2026
summary: Broadcasters’ union says vote required after several nations threaten potential boycott The European Broadcasting Union has confirmed it will hold an online vote in November that could see the Israeli broadcaster Kan expelled from next year’s Eurovision song contest. In a letter sent to the contests’ participating broadcasters on Thursday, the EBU president, Delphine Ernotte-Cunci, wrote that there was an “unprecedented diversity of views” on Israel’s participation in Eurovision and that the issue required “a broader democratic basis”.
